pairs.target: nài lěi lái de shíhòu , tǎ wéi zhèng dūn zài yuànlǐ , shìtú bǎ túbǎn jiǎo shàng de yìgēn yóubù shéngjié jiěkāi . tā cóng ménwài hǎn le tā yìshēng , zǒujìn xiān kàn nà jié , shuō ruò dǎsuàn jiě yíshàngwǔ , bùrú nálái shuān chuán .
pairs.english: When Nerai arrived, Tavi was crouching in the courtyard trying to untie an oilcloth knot on his drawing board. She called from the gate, inspected the knot, and said if he planned a whole morning on it, he might as well moor a boat with it.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾来的时候，塔维正蹲在院里，试图把图板角上的一根油布绳结解开。她从门外喊了他一声，走近先看那结，说若打算解一上午，不如拿来拴船。

pairs.target: tā táitóu , kànjiàn tā xuē bāng shàng de ní yǐjīng gān chéng huībáisè . bái pái cáng zài wàiyī lǐ , kuà dài de pí kòu què huàn le yìzhī , yánsè xīn dé xiǎnyǎn .
pairs.english: He looked up at gray-white dried mud on her boot uppers. Her white tally was inside her coat, but a replacement leather bag buckle looked conspicuously new.
pairs.hanzi: 他抬头，看见她靴帮上的泥已经干成灰白色。白牌藏在外衣里，挎袋的皮扣却换了一只，颜色新得显眼。

pairs.target: tā jiàn tā dīng zhe , xiān shuō kòuzǐ zài lùshang duàn le , búshì shénme xīn dìfāng de biāojì . " wǒ méi wèn . " tǎ wéi shuō . " nǐ de yǎnjīng xiān wèn le . "
pairs.english: Seeing him stare, she said the buckle had broken on the road; it wasn't some new place's badge. “I didn't ask,” Tavi said. “Your eyes asked first.”
pairs.hanzi:
她见他盯着，先说扣子在路上断了，不是什么新地方的标记。
“我没问。”塔维说。
“你的眼睛先问了。”

pairs.target: ruǎn héng duān zhe chá chūlái , jiāng yì fáng liú de xuégōng láixìn jiāogěi tā . nài lěi zài zhuōqián chāikāi , bǎ qiānguò de fù yè hé zìjǐ shǒulǐ de yuēdìng fàngdào yíchù , zhútiáo hé le rìzi yǔ dài jiào .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng brought tea and handed her the academy letter held at the station. Nerai opened it at the table, comparing the signed copy with her agreement, checking dates and supervision item by item.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡端着茶出来，将驿房留的学宫来信交给她。奈蕾在桌前拆开，把签过的副页和自己手里的约定放到一处，逐条核了日子与带教。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng xiānqián jì de yánwù bàoxìn chù , tā tiān le shuǐlù jiē yì de guìtái , bú jiào rén zhī wǎng jiù lùshang zhǎo .
pairs.english: She added the water-route station counter to Ruan Heng's delay-report contacts, so people wouldn't search only along the old road.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡先前记的延误报信处，她添了水路接驿的柜台，不叫人只往旧路上找。

pairs.target: shuōqǐ bātiān de chóujīn , tā jiāng tóu liǎngtiān de shù xiān fùgěi tǎ wéi , yúxià zhào shíjì zuò guò de gōng rì jié .
pairs.english: For the eight days' payment she gave Tavi the first two days' amount upfront, the remainder to be settled by days actually worked.
pairs.hanzi: 说起八天的酬金，她将头两天的数先付给塔维，余下照实际做过的工日结。

pairs.target: chēchuán hé zhùchù lìng suàn , bù cóng tā shǒulǐ kòu , bù jiāng yuányǒu shí zuò bǔtiē tōutōu nuózuò zhèbǐ qián .
pairs.english: Transport and lodging were separate, not deducted from his pay or quietly taken from the existing placement stipend.
pairs.hanzi: 车船和住处另算，不从他手里扣，不将原有实作补贴偷偷挪作这笔钱。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiēguò shí , shǒuzhǐ hái yǒudiǎn jiě shéngjié mó chūlái de hóng yìn . tā běnlái xiǎng bǎ qián tóngxué gōng nà yè jiá zài yìqǐ , nài lěi shuō zhǐ guī zhǐ , qián fàng tuǒ , diào le bié zhǐwàng yì fáng de rén tì nǐ cóng ní lǐ lāo .
pairs.english: His fingers still bore red knot-rubbing marks as he took it. He meant to file the money with the academy page; Nerai said paper was paper, money should be kept safe, and station staff weren't there to fish it out of mud for him.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维接过时，手指还有点解绳结磨出来的红印。他本来想把钱同学宫那页夹在一起，奈蕾说纸归纸，钱放妥，掉了别指望驿房的人替你从泥里捞。

pairs.target: tā yǐjīng kànguò tā nà zhāng tái jǐng wǎngfǎn tú , wèn tā kōng zhe de shuǐgōu hòulái zǒuguò méiyǒu .
pairs.english: She'd already seen his Moss Well round-trip map and asked if he'd since walked the blank ditch section.
pairs.hanzi: 她已经看过他那张苔井往返图，问他空着的水沟后来走过没有。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō méiyǒu , zhèhuí chēshàng yě zhī wàngjiàn . tā yǐwéi tā háiyào wèn wèishénme bù bǔ mǎn , nài lěi quèshuō nà jiù xiān kōng zhe , zìjǐ qùnián yě yǒu yì jié túhuà dé tài mǎn , rújīn dé qù tóng zhù zài shàngtóu de rén chóngxīn shuōhuà .
pairs.english: Tavi said no; this time too he'd only seen it from the cart. He expected a question about filling the gap, but Nerai said leave it blank: she'd overfilled part of last year's map herself and now must talk again with people living there.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说没有，这回车上也只望见。他以为她还要问为什么不补满，奈蕾却说那就先空着，自己去年也有一截图画得太满，如今得去同住在上头的人重新说话。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng zài pángbiān tīng , méiyǒu tì tā jiāng zhèhuà jiǎng chéng yìtángkè . tā jiāng tǎ wéi jiāodào tā zhè duàn gōngzuò lǐ , línzǒu zhī jiào tā měi huàn yíchù jiē yì biàn liú xùn , jǐrì méiyǒu xiāoxī , zìjǐ cáinéng zhīdào wǎng nǎlǐ wèn , búbì děng chū liǎo shì cái xiǎngqǐ bàopíngān .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng listened without turning her words into a lesson. Handing Tavi over for this work, he only asked him to leave messages at each station change, so after days without news he'd know where to ask, rather than remembering to report only after trouble.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡在旁边听，没有替她将这话讲成一堂课。他将塔维交到她这段工作里，临走只叫他每换一处接驿便留讯，几日没有消息，自己才能知道往哪里问，不必等出了事才想起报平安。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi sòng tā dào yuàn wài de chē biān , hūrán bù zhīdào gāi bǎshǒu fàngzài nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi saw him to the cart outside and suddenly didn't know where to put his hands.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维送他到院外的车边，忽然不知道该把手放在哪里。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng jiāng bēibāo kuà hǎo , xiān tóng chēfū wèn le huíchéng , cái huítóu shuō , dù chéng ruò yòu huà yú , huílái tì tā kàn . tǎ wéi dāying , tā biàn shàngchē , méi zài zhàn zài tàbǎn shàng shuō yíbiàn suǒyǒu guījǔ .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng shouldered his bag, asked the driver about the return journey, then said if Du Cheng drew another fish Tavi should inspect it for him on return. Tavi agreed; he boarded without repeating every rule on the step.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡将背包挎好，先同车夫问了回程，才回头说，杜澄若又画鱼，回来替他看。塔维答应，他便上车，没再站在踏板上说一遍所有规矩。

pairs.target: chē guò liǔshù hòu , nài lěi cóng ménkǒu jiào tā lái chī zǎofàn . tā zìjǐ jiāng shèng de yíkuài bǐng zhé kāi jiácài , wèn tā shìfǒu yǐwéi yuèjiè kè dōu búbì zuòzài yì fánglǐ děng rè zhōu .
pairs.english: After the cart passed the willows, Nerai called him to breakfast, folding vegetables into her remaining bread and asking whether he thought Outriders never waited for hot porridge in stations.
pairs.hanzi: 车过柳树后，奈蕾从门口叫他来吃早饭。她自己将剩的一块饼折开夹菜，问他是否以为越界客都不必坐在驿房里等热粥。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō zhǐshì bù zhīdào jīntiān yào zuò shénme , tā biàn jiāng yìzhāng gānjìng de zhǐ tuīguòlái , shuō xiān tóng guǎn chēchuán de rén bǎ míngrì zhè duàn lù wènqīng , zài qù zhǎo rén rèn tú shàng de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Tavi said he simply didn't know what today's work was. She pushed over clean paper: first clarify tomorrow's journey with the transport people, then find someone to identify places on the map.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说只是不知道今天要做什么，她便将一张干净的纸推过来，说先同管车船的人把明日这段路问清，再去找人认图上的地方。

pairs.target: yì fáng zhǎngguì nálái liǎngzhǒng shíkè : gōnglù chē dào huàn chuán chù de , dùchuán suí shuǐwèi huànshàng xià àn de .
pairs.english: The station keeper brought two timetables: the road cart to the boat transfer, and ferries switching between upper and lower landings with water level.
pairs.hanzi: 驿房掌柜拿来两种时刻：公路车到换船处的，渡船随水位换上下岸的。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiān bǎ tāmen chāo chéng yìtiáo zhěngqí de xiàn , xiě dào zhōngjiān , fāxiàn yíchù liú le bàngè shíchén , què méi shuōmíng zài ànshàng děng , háishì chuán yǐjīng zǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi first copied them into one neat line, then found half a double-hour left unexplained: waiting on shore, or the boat already gone?
pairs.hanzi: 塔维先把它们抄成一条整齐的线，写到中间，发现一处留了半个时辰，却没说明在岸上等，还是船已经走。

pairs.target: tā ná zhe zhǐ qù wèn , zhǎngguì jiāng zhèngzài shù de língqián gàizhù , shuō ruò chuán xiān zǒu le , nǐ děng de shì xià yìzhī , búshì ràng tóngyì zhī huítóu lái jiē .
pairs.english: He took the paper to ask. The keeper covered the coins he was counting: if the boat left first, you'd wait for the next, not make the same one turn back for you.
pairs.hanzi: 他拿着纸去问，掌柜将正在数的零钱盖住，说若船先走了，你等的是下一只，不是让同一只回头来接。

pairs.target: nài lěi méi tì tā dá , yě méi cuī tā gǎnjǐn huà wán . tā zìjǐ zài pángbiān wèn qùnián bān guò yícì de huòzhàn rújīn shuí guǎn , wèn chū yíwèi lǎohuǒjì hái zài , què dé wǔhòu cái lái .
pairs.english: Nerai neither answered for him nor hurried his drawing. She asked who now ran the warehouse that moved last year, finding an old worker remained but wouldn't arrive until afternoon.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾没替他答，也没催他赶紧画完。她自己在旁边问去年搬过一次的货栈如今谁管，问出一位老伙计还在，却得午后才来。

pairs.target: tāmen biàn xiān qù mǎi lùshang néng chī de dōngxī , bàngwǎn zài huílái zhǎo nàge rén .
pairs.english: They bought travel food first and returned for him that evening.
pairs.hanzi: 他们便先去买路上能吃的东西，傍晚再回来找那个人。

pairs.target: zhōngwǔ tǎ wéi dào yóuwù guìtái , fùqián gěi sè lā hé xuégōng péngyǒu gèjì le duǎnjiān , xiěmíng yǐ dào bái péng yì , cìrì wǎng shí tīng zǒu , huíxìn réng zǒu xuégōng de zhuǎnjì chù .
pairs.english: At noon Tavi paid at the postal counter to send notes to Sela and his academy friends: arrived at White Awning Station, onward to Shiting tomorrow, replies still forwarded through the academy.
pairs.hanzi: 中午塔维到邮务柜台，付钱给瑟拉和学宫朋友各寄了短笺，写明已到白棚驿，次日往石汀走，回信仍走学宫的转寄处。

pairs.target: tā méi xiě nà zhī wūdǐng jī yǐ jiàn zhe , yě méi jiào shuí jiāng gěi chí ān de wèn xìn lìng guǎi dào shuǐlù shanglái .
pairs.english: He didn't claim he'd seen the roof chicken, nor ask anyone to reroute his inquiry to Chian onto the water route.
pairs.hanzi: 他没写那只屋顶鸡已见着，也没叫谁将给迟安的问信另拐到水路上来。

pairs.target: wǔhòu fēng cóng péngdǐng chuānguò , wěixí de yǐng luò zài zhuōmiàn , xiàng yìtiáotiáo qiǎnqiǎnde shuǐwén .
pairs.english: Afternoon wind passed through the roof; reed-mat shadows fell across the table like shallow ripples.
pairs.hanzi: 午后风从棚顶穿过，苇席的影落在桌面，像一条条浅浅的水纹。

pairs.target: nài lěi tóng nàwèi lǎohuǒjì shuōhuà shí , jiāng bái pái cóng yīlǐng lǐ jiě xiàlái gē zài pángbiān , shěngde shéngzi mó bózi .
pairs.english: Talking with the old worker, Nerai untied the white tally from her collar and set it aside to keep the cord from chafing her neck.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾同那位老伙计说话时，将白牌从衣领里解下来搁在旁边，省得绳子磨脖子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànjiàn sāndào héng hén , biānshàng yǒu yídào jiù kē kǒu , cā dé hěn gānjìng , méiyǒu bǔ .
pairs.english: Tavi saw three horizontal notches and an old chip at the edge, cleaned but unrepaired.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看见三道横痕，边上有一道旧磕口，擦得很干净，没有补。

pairs.target: tā hūrán xiǎngqǐ bù yǐngxì lǐ dìwǔ shànmén , jiāng nà chū xì jiǎng gěi tā tīng , wèn tā kàn méi kànguò .
pairs.english: He remembered the shadow play's fifth door, described it, and asked if she'd seen it.
pairs.hanzi: 他忽然想起布影戏里第五扇门，将那出戏讲给她听，问她看没看过。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō kànguò dàigǒu de , yě kànguò méi gǒu de , xiǎoshíhòu zuì nǎo de búshì mén guānshàng , shì chàng dào fēn liáng jiù méiwán , màichá de rén chènjī lái dìèrtàng .
pairs.english: Nerai had seen versions with and without dogs. As a child she'd hated not the closing door but the endless grain-division song, giving the tea seller a second round.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说看过带狗的，也看过没狗的，小时候最恼的不是门关上，是唱到分粮就没完，卖茶的人趁机来第二趟。

pairs.target: lǎohuǒjì xiào dé tíng le bǐ , shuō zìjǐ nàlǐ de bǎnběn , màichá de rén háiyǒu yíduàn chàngcí . nài lěi shuō nà gèng bùnéng kàn .
pairs.english: The worker laughed until he stopped writing, saying his version gave the tea seller a song too. Nerai said that was even less watchable.
pairs.hanzi: 老伙计笑得停了笔，说自己那里的版本，卖茶的人还有一段唱词。奈蕾说那更不能看。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dītóu kàn zìjǐ de zhǐ , yìtiáo gāi huà xiàng ànbiān de duǎnxiàn bèi tā xiào dé tuōcháng le , tā méi jí zhe cā , xiān bǎ zhuōshàng de cháwǎn nuókāi .
pairs.english: Tavi looked down at his paper: laughter had stretched a short shoreward line. Before erasing, he moved the tea bowl aside.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维低头看自己的纸，一条该画向岸边的短线被他笑得拖长了，他没急着擦，先把桌上的茶碗挪开。
